visionPalettes.name: 흰 배경 위 블랙 레이어 페이드
visionPalettes.foreground: White on black, neutral black on white, then white over the films
visionPalettes.scope: V4 vision only. A constant shared white --surface backs a separate #181818 stage pseudo-element. The black layer changes only opacity; the background color is no longer interpolated. No global foundation change.
visionPalettes.behavior: The decorative black layer fades from 100% to 0% opacity during t=.1–.6, revealing the white surface behind it. Its isolated negative stacking level stays behind lettering and films and never intercepts input. White film lettering returns at t=1.2–1.6. The last film and caption remain on the stage as it releases at t=6.6; the section then scrolls away over one actual visible stage height. Reverse scroll restores opacity continuously. Reduced-motion and short static layouts retain an opaque black layer with white lettering, with no sticky runway.
visionPalettes.verification: Automated motion coverage includes the final-film hold, media stop, reverse scrolling, neutral palette timing and unchanged reference-page exits. Browser visual verification not performed.

visionTypography: Use the existing --hero-title-size foundation token (59px default) for the vision slogan and its hidden keyword guides above 768px and in explicit desktop-canvas mode. Retain the previous small-screen responsive sizing. Recompute motion coordinates on foundation theme changes. The dedicated Hanwha reference page keeps its source-derived scale.

pageNavigation.content: Remove 01–05 from visible and accessible labels. Rename 처음 to 소개. Keep the five existing anchor targets; the shared scroll engine colors the active section label red.
pageNavigation.interaction: All names remain visible without hovering, on desktop and narrow screens. Clicking a label keeps the existing section scroll behavior.
pageNavigation.fallback: Hide at 850px and below, or whenever the viewport is narrower than the desktop header foundation width (--content-max + twice --page-gutter; currently 1392px). Re-evaluate on resize and theme changes without overwriting the saved visibility choice. Also hide during menus, dialogs, background tabs and footer, and while the layout tweak disables the rail. Start hidden until the first width check to avoid flashing on narrow screens.
pageNavigation.verification: 10 existing navigation and shared motion checks passed. All five text-only links and section targets checked. Browser visual verification not performed.
